hypothesis: A fixed source-scaled prior and averaging over residual directions/scales may generalize better than A5's unpenalized maximum-likelihood hard selection.
model_family: The original eta source components, each either unchanged or augmented by delta * e_j e_j^T for one existing public nonintercept function. No source covariance, intercept, discrepancy, f/g model, paid query path or dictionary normalization is replaced.
prior: Probability 0.5 on no residual correction; probability 0.5 on a residual direction uniform over the 68 public functions. Conditional delta has an exponential prior whose mean is the generic same-source total nonintercept covariance trace. The original source-component weights remain equal before paid target observations. The same residual prior is used for both controls.
inference: Integrate the exponential scale prior with 48-node Gauss-Laguerre quadrature. Average original source components, the null branch and all direction/scale branches by training-only marginal likelihood; score held-out labels using the complete predictive mixture, not moment matching.
validation: Reuse the exact A3 candidate-group holdouts and old scores, excluding all repeated observations at the held candidate. No target truth, support, verifier outcomes, held-out labels or A5 winning directions enter fitting. Source variance scale, null probability and quadrature order are fixed before results; no hyperparameter search.
scoring: All five strata, both source controls, both prefixes, paired seed changes and nominal bootstrap intervals. Primary endpoint remains 24-batch learned-source held-out log score.
recommendation_replay_gate: Broad held-out predictive improvement with no material compatible-regime regression is needed before recommendation replay. A gain confined to a chosen stratum, or a clear shared-structure loss, stops replay. No new closed-loop pilot is authorized by predictive gains alone.
limitations: This averages a one-extra-direction model family, not arbitrary joint target support. Null mass and the exponential source-scale prior supply regularization as well as uncertainty averaging. Existing adaptive query paths do not establish prospective or verified-reward gains.
